testsuite.name: com.crush.mobile.execution.ExecutionRoomRoundtripTest

testcase.name: a confirmed run advances only an acknowledged row
an execution row roundtrips a restart byte-faithfully
migration chain preserves project and handoff rows and creates executions
stale phase writes are guarded no-ops
v4 to v5 copies the lease value into the canonical column
stale writes cannot clobber ambiguity or an unknown outcome
